scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,worker,web -c "cyan,magenta,green" "npm run -w apps/api dev" "npm run -w apps/api worker:dev" "npm run -w apps/web dev"
scripts.build: npm run -w packages/shared build && npm run -w apps/api build && npm run -w apps/web build
scripts.typecheck: npm run -w packages/shared typecheck && npm run -w apps/api typecheck && npm run -w apps/web typecheck
scripts.lint: npm run -w apps/api lint && npm run -w apps/web lint
